record.paper_title: Open questions for operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics
record.context_brief: Schur inclusions for hooks and h-hat
record.original_question: For coprime positive integers a and b, consecutive hook shapes (j+1|k-1) and (j|k), and the normalized Schur-seed functions s_hat_(j+1|k-1)^(a,b)(x;q,t) and s_hat_(j|k)^(a,b)(x;q,t), prove the Schur inclusion q s_hat_(j+1|k-1)^(a,b)(x;q,t) <=_s s_hat_(j|k)^(a,b)(x;q,t), where <=_s means that the difference is Schur-positive. Also, for all positive integers m and n, prove the Schur inclusion q^beta e_{m-1,n}(x;q,t) <=_s h_hat_{m,n}(x;q,t), where beta is the number of points between the diagonal-avoiding (m,n)-staircase path and the (m-1,n)-staircase path as defined in the source.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Lambda$ denote the ring of symmetric functions in variables $x=(x_1,x_2,\ldots)$ over $\mathbb{Q}(q,t)$, with Schur basis $\{s_\lambda\}$, elementary basis $\{e_\lambda\}$, and modified Macdonald-type "hat" normalizations of symmetric functions indexed by pairs $(m,n)$ of positive integers, as arising in rectangular $(q,t)$-Catalan combinatorics. For coprime positive integers $a,b$, let $\hat s^{(a,b)}_{(j\,|\,k)}(x;q,t)$ denote the normalized Schur-seed symmetric function associated with the hook partition $(j\,|\,k)$ (the hook with arm $j$ and leg $k$ in Frobenius notation) inside the $(a,b)$-rectangular setting. For positive integers $m,n$, let $e_{m,n}(x;q,t)$ and $\hat h_{m,n}(x;q,t)$ denote the corresponding "elementary" and "hat-complete" symmetric functions associated with the $(m,n)$ rectangle.

Write $f \leq_s g$ to mean that $g-f$ is Schur-positive, i.e.\ expands in the Schur basis with coefficients in $\mathbb{N}[q,t]$.

Let $\beta(m,n)$ be the number of lattice points strictly between the highest diagonal-avoiding lattice path from $(0,0)$ to $(m,n)$ (the $(m,n)$-staircase path) and the analogous $(m-1,n)$-staircase path.

Prove the following Schur inclusions:

(a) For all coprime positive integers $a,b$ and all integers $j\ge 0$, $k\ge 1$,
$$q\,\hat s^{(a,b)}_{(j+1\,|\,k-1)}(x;q,t)\;\leq_s\;\hat s^{(a,b)}_{(j\,|\,k)}(x;q,t).$$

(b) For all positive integers $m,n$,
$$q^{\beta(m,n)}\,e_{m-1,n}(x;q,t)\;\leq_s\;\hat h_{m,n}(x;q,t).$$
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears as one of the open questions posed in Bergeron's 2016 work on operators related to rectangular Catalan combinatorics. Subsequent surveys (2021) by the same author and related work on Schur positivity in the rectangular Catalan / Macdonald setting do not record a proof of these specific Schur inclusions, suggesting the conjecture remains open.

status_evidence.title: Open Questions for operators related to Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics
status_evidence.snippet: The paper formulates open questions regarding Schur positivity and Schur inclusion of symmetric functions arising from operators in the elliptic Hall algebra.

status_evidence.title: Symmetric Functions and Rectangular Catalan Combinatorics (2021 survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey by Bergeron updating rectangular Catalan combinatorics; the Schur-inclusion conjectures for hooks and h-hat are reiterated rather than resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Still listed as conjectural in later survey.
